title: Double Integral of x^2 + y^2 over a Circular Disk
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate iint_D (x^2 + y^2) dA where D is the circular disk x^2 + y^2 <= 4.

steps.title: Convert Integrand and Region to Polar Coordinates
steps.mathExpression: x^2 + y^2 = r^2, \quad dA = r \, dr \, d\theta; \quad 0 \le r \le 2, \; 0 \le \theta \le 2\pi
steps.explanation: Substitute r^2 for x^2 + y^2 and include factor r in area element.

steps.title: Set Up and Separate Iterated Integrals
steps.mathExpression: \int_0^{2\pi} d\theta \int_0^2 r^2 \cdot r \, dr = (2\pi) \int_0^2 r^3 \, dr = 2\pi \left[ \frac{r^4}{4} \right]_0^2 = 2\pi \left( \frac{16}{4} \right) = 8\pi
steps.explanation: Integrate r^3 over [0, 2] and multiply by 2*pi.
